scenario: A skill registry with three skills and dependency declarations needs to be compiled into an executable DAG with acyclicity, reachability, and goal completeness verified.
prompt: build a typed skill graph from the registry, dependency declarations, and goal specification; classify edges, compile a DAG, verify acyclicity and goal completeness, and emit a SkillGraph with a repair plan.
context: repo skills-quirk on branch main, node 24
the skill registry contains spec-driven-development, implement, and review-pr with capabilities, inputs, outputs, and dependencies
dependency declarations classify edges as dependency/workflow/semantic/alternative with state/data/order roles
the goal specification requires capabilities and accepted outputs
every edge carries exactly one edgeType and one role; undeclared edges are absent
the graph must be acyclic before compilation; cycles are violations
grounding: .agents/skills/graph/skill-graph-engineering/SKILL.md#Explicit rules - edge typing, acyclicity, reachability, goal completeness, locality-bounded repair
.agents/skills/graph/skill-graph-engineering/SKILL.md#Workflow - register skills, declare dependencies, build graph, verify properties, compile DAG, emit repair plan
.agents/skills/graph/skill-graph-engineering/SKILL.md#Guardrails - locality-bounded repair, no cycles, goal completeness check, no implicit edges

instructionFollowing.criterion: Every edge is typed as dependency, workflow, semantic, or alternative with a role of state, data, or order.

levels.4: all edges have exactly one edgeType and one role
levels.2: most edges are typed but some lack a role or edgeType

instructionFollowing.criterion: The graph is verified acyclic before compilation; cycles are violations, not execution hints.

levels.4: acyclicity is verified and cycles, if any, are violations

instructionFollowing.criterion: Goal completeness requires every requiredCapability to be provided by a reachable node emitting an acceptedOutput.

levels.4: all required capabilities are covered by reachable nodes emitting accepted outputs
levels.2: most capabilities are covered but some are missing
levels.0: no goal completeness check is performed

instructionFollowing.criterion: Repair is locality-bounded; operators touch only the affected subgraph and no operator introduces a cycle.

levels.4: repair operators are bounded to the affected subgraph and preserve acyclicity
levels.2: repair is attempted but not clearly bounded or may introduce cycles

goalCompletion.criterion: The DAG is compiled with topologicalOrder and levels, and dag.executable is true only when all properties hold.

levels.4: topologicalOrder and levels are produced; executable is true only when acyclic, reachable, and goalComplete
levels.2: DAG structure is partial or executable is set without verifying all properties

goalCompletion.criterion: Reachability is verified from entry nodes to every goal-required node.

levels.4: all goal-required nodes are reachable from entry nodes
levels.2: most goal-required nodes are reachable but some are not

goalCompletion.criterion: The executability verdict reports acyclic, reachable, goalComplete, executable, and violations.

levels.4: all five verdict fields are populated accurately
levels.2: verdict is present but some fields are missing or inaccurate

goalCompletion.criterion: The SkillGraph artifact is emitted as JSON and Markdown with provenance and validated.

levels.4: artifact saved in both formats with provenance and validation passes
levels.2: artifact produced but not saved in both formats or validation skipped

check.note: the SkillGraph must contain all required top-level fields
the DAG must include topological order, levels, and executable flag
executability must report acyclic, reachable, goalComplete, and violations

assertions.note: the skill graph must contain sufficient detail beyond a trivial stub

check.criterion: Is the graph verified acyclic before compilation, with cycles treated as violations?

levels.pass: acyclicity is verified and cycles are violations
levels.fail: acyclicity is not verified or cycles are treated as execution hints

check.criterion: Is every required capability provided by a reachable node emitting an accepted output?

levels.fail: one or more required capabilities are uncovered

check.criterion: Are repair operators locality-bounded and do they preserve acyclicity?

levels.pass: operators are bounded to the affected subgraph and preserve acyclicity
levels.fail: operators are unbounded or may introduce cycles
